meta.description: LSP-Brains Brain — first Brain scoring a specification rather than a codebase. Seven advisory domains measure spec quality: completeness, schema validity, link integrity, glossary freshness, diagram sync, RFC 2119 compliance, changelog hygiene. 'Ideas as code' — the methodology is a scorable subject like anything else.
meta.note: All domains advisory (weight 0.0) for v1 — sensory tools are future work. CMDBs are stubs at score 0 until the sensory tools are built. This is the honest state per spec principle #2.

domain_definitions._doc: All domains read CMDB stubs until sensory tools land. Placeholder scores at 0 reflect unknown state; per spec principle #2 (scoring must be honest), unknown is not good.

skill-coherence._doc: B-11 (2026-04-22, drift-detection scope): byte-level coherence between duplicated skill files across sibling/child Brains in the fractal topology. Refresh: `neurogrim sensory skill-coherence --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/skill-coherence-cmdb.json`. Advisory-only in v1.

capability-hygiene._doc: B-12 (2026-04-22): scores skill description-block quality against the authoring standard in write-skill.md. The 1,536-char description block IS the routing contract in Claude Code's native skill index. Refresh: `neurogrim sensory capability-hygiene --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/capability-hygiene-cmdb.json`. Advisory-only in v1.

supply-chain-sca._doc: E-SC-10 (2026-04-26): supply-chain awareness Layer 1 (mechanical SCA) per LSP-Brains v2.6 §16.2. **This is a spec repo with no Cargo.lock or runtime pyproject.toml at root** — the sensory/ directory contains example-scoped Python tools, not runtime deps. Sensor reports `sensor_status: lockfile_unreadable` + score 0; advisory weight 0.0 means this doesn't affect the unified score. Domain registered for cross-ecosystem symmetry + visibility into the spec repo's supply-chain posture (which is: no runtime supply-chain surface). Refresh: `neurogrim sensory supply-chain-sca --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/supply-chain-sca-cmdb.json`. The sensor is implemented in NeuroGrim per spec §16.9; this Brain consumes its CMDB output.

supply-chain-vigilance._doc: E-SC-10 (2026-04-26): supply-chain Layer 2 (deep-signal vigilance) per LSP-Brains v2.6 §16.3. Same no-deps reality as supply-chain-sca above; the seven sub-sensors have nothing to scan. Domain registered for symmetry. Refresh: `neurogrim sensory supply-chain-vigilance --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/supply-chain-vigilance-cmdb.json`.

supply-chain-review._doc: E-SC-10 (2026-04-26): supply-chain Layer 3 (agent-assisted human review framework) per LSP-Brains v2.6 §16.4. With no L1/L2 findings to triage, no review tickets are created. Score 100 (zero open tickets) is the steady state. Domain registered for symmetry + as the home for any operator-initiated tickets about the spec repo's tooling deps. Refresh: `neurogrim sensory supply-chain-review --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/supply-chain-review-cmdb.json`.

domain-calibration._doc: E-B2-2 (2026-04-27): Brains-2.0 per-domain calibration meta-observer per LSP-Brains v2.8 §17.9. Reads .claude/brain/*-calibration-ledger*.jsonl and reports calibration health. The spec repo has only advisory domains today, so calibration ledgers will be empty in the steady state. Domain registered for symmetry across the four-Brain ecosystem and to surface any operator-initiated entries about spec-quality calibrations as the seven advisory domains evolve. Default weight 0.0. Refresh: `neurogrim sensory domain-calibration --project-root D:/Brains/LSP-Brains/ > .claude/domain-calibration-cmdb.json`.

Publishing a spec version requires human approval
